title: Taxonomy of Commitment Stages and Dissolution Burdens

columns.label: Dissolution Rule & Participant Burden
columns.description: Who bears the cost if the collective position fails

cells.person: Zero cost; immediate frictionless exit without residual obligation
Signal of shared constraint; outside option remains 100% active
Escrowed intent; automatic full refund if supplier fails constraint gate
Contractual lock-in; mutual liability governed by statutory consumer rights

caption: Taxonomy showing that ratification is not commitment, and establishing zero-penalty dissolution floors prior to binding execution.
scopeLimits: Conceptual framework. Does not specify payment rail implementations.
limitations: Theoretical distinction; real-world enforcement depends on legal jurisdiction.

accessibility.textEquivalent: Table categorizing 4 commitment stages from Expressed Interest to Binding Execution alongside their corresponding dissolution rules and participant burdens.
